cases.question: Which quantities can I reserve, and what happens for zero, a fractional quantity, or more units than are available?

facts.text: Only positive safe integers are accepted.
Zero/fractional quantities throw INVALID_QUANTITY without allocating stock.
Excess demand throws OUT_OF_STOCK and leaves stock unchanged.

verification.scope: Independent executable assertions at the frozen commit.

cases.question: What are shipping and total charges for merchandise subtotals of 7499 cents and exactly 7500 cents? What units are the amounts in?

facts.text: 7499 cents subtotal: shipping 499, total 7998 cents.
7500 cents subtotal: shipping 0, total 7500 cents; threshold is inclusive.
Amounts are integer cents, not dollars.

verification.scope: Independent executable assertions at the frozen commit.

cases.question: If I pass a clock returning 1000 to createShop and reserve a notebook, what expiresAt is returned and where is that deadline computed?

facts.text: expiresAt is 901000 milliseconds; lifetime is 900000 milliseconds.
createShop forwards the injected clock to createReservations; reserve adds the lifetime to now().

verification.scope: Independent executable assertions at the frozen commit.

cases.question: When does an expired reservation return stock? Does cleanup happen at the exact deadline, which operations trigger it, and can repeated stock reads release the same units twice?

facts.text: At or after expiresAt, active reservations expire.
reserve, checkout, and available trigger lazy cleanup; there is no background timer.
Status becomes expired before inventory.release; only active entries are processed, preventing repeated release.

verification.scope: Independent executable assertions at the frozen commit.

cases.question: Trace checkout of a reservation for two notebooks from the shop API to its receipt. Which modules supply the quantity, unit price, subtotal, shipping, and total, and what are the amounts?

facts.text: Shop calls reservations.checkout then looks up the catalog product and makes lines with the reservation quantity.
Notebook unit price 1500 cents; quantity 2; subtotal 3000; shipping 499; total 3499 cents.
Shop passes lines to calculateOrder in pricing.js and returns its totals with reservationId and lines.

verification.scope: Independent executable assertions at the frozen commit.

cases.question: What happens if I check out the same reservation twice? If I later advance the clock past its deadline, does its stock come back?

facts.text: Second checkout throws ALREADY_CHECKED_OUT after the first changes status to checked-out.
Checked-out reservations never expire/release stock, since cleanup requires active status.

verification.scope: Independent executable assertions at the frozen commit.

cases.question: Can changing quantity, status, or expiresAt on the object returned by reserve alter the stored reservation or the quantity charged at checkout? Explain the mechanism.

facts.text: reserve returns a shallow spread copy, while the original object is stored in its Map.
These fields are primitive values; changing them on the returned object does not change the stored reservation or checkout quantity. This is not a general deep-copy guarantee.

verification.scope: Independent executable assertions at the frozen commit.

cases.question: Can I change the reservation lifetime with an environment variable in this revision? If so, what variable and units should I use?

facts.text: No environment variable configures reservation lifetime at this frozen revision; do not invent a variable name.
reservationLifetimeMs returns a hardcoded 15 * 60 * 1000 milliseconds, consumed by reserve; changing the policy requires a code change.

verification.scope: Inspected every tracked source module and manifest; targeted fresh-process tests establish behavior. Missing retrieval is never proof of absence.

cases.question: After restarting the process, will a new shop recover reduced inventory and outstanding reservation IDs? Where is that state persisted?

facts.text: There is no persistence/recovery in this repository; inventory and reservations are per-instance Maps.
New shop constructs inventory from catalog and a fresh reservation Map; stock resets, old IDs yield RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND.
External durable storage would need to be implemented by the caller; no database or storage file is configured here.

history.content: What happens to reserved notebook stock when the reservation expires?
Expired active reservations return their allocated units to available inventory when cleanup runs.

cases.question: Which function restores those units, and why only once?

facts.text: createReservations.expireAt calls inventory.release(productId, quantity); release adds quantity to available stock.
Only active reservations at/past the deadline qualify; setting status to expired prevents repeated release.

verification.scope: Independent executable assertions at the frozen commit.
